name: ATLAS Tile Calorimeter: Technical Design Report
notes: Date recorded at year precision: the INSPIRE literature-record listing (src:atlas-tdrs-inspire-1990s) gives the report number and recid but not an exact month/day.

summary.plain: The engineering plan for the scintillator-tile calorimeter that measures the energy of hadrons and jets in the barrel of ATLAS.
summary.technical: ATLAS Tile Calorimeter TDR (CERN-LHCC-96-42, 1996): design of the steel/scintillator sampling hadronic calorimeter, about 420,000 tiles read out by wavelength-shifting fibres.
